34.6837,-77.94327: Timothy Bloodworth. U.S. Senator, 1795-1801; member, U.S. House, in First Congress, 1790-91. Opposed ratification of U.S. Constitution, 1788, 1789. Lived near here.
34.92473,-77.77871: James M. Sprunt 1818 1884. Educator, botanist, C.S.A. chaplain, county official, & Presbyterian minister. His grave is 4 mi. West.
34.95874,-77.96865: Grove Church. Presbyterian. First church founded by Scotch-Irish who settled here about 1736.
34.99508,-77.92429: William Houston. Stamp master of North Carolina, 1765, resigned during demonstration in Wilmington against the Stamp Act; a physician at Sarecta, four mi. E.
